questions.q: What is the linking word used to indicate a reason?

questions.q: What is the linking word used to show contrast?

questions.q: Choose the correct linking word: *Although she prepared the food, she didn't eat it.*

questions.why: Although is used to show a contrast between preparation and not eating.
